scope: 45 audited feature rows; preservation plan only. Prototype demonstrates layout, not full functional parity.

primaryScope.shield: DPI profile plus selected DNS and Telegram components
primaryScope.vpn: Separate server route; requires application process
primaryScope.unknown: Status/ownership preflight before every mutation; mini unknown primary action is Check status
primaryScope.componentToggle: Current on/off commands remain separate from on-connect preferences; no combined aria-checked

features.guard: Perform ownership/readiness preflight; scope DPI plus explicitly chosen DNS/TG; no implied VPN.

features.target: Mini and Overview / confirmed shield disconnect
features.guard: Confirm actual stop/rollback; explicit off persists; never destroy unrelated configuration.
Retain Cancel while actual operation is cancellable; completed animation does not acknowledge cancel.

features.target: Mini / on-connect preferences and separate current-component actions
features.guard: Preference and actual state stay distinct. Retain direct start/stop commands on current DNS/TG state with accessible names.
Unknown/error/stale not ready; observe generation and last successful checkedAt.

features.target: Overview / separate server-route card and Connection screen
features.guard: Retain direct connect/disconnect from Overview without navigating through advanced settings; route does not become a shield operation.
Keep selected nodeId via atomic targeted mutation; selection does not start a route.

features.target: Overview / DNS current action and DNS screen
features.guard: Direct observed-state action remains; link/selection cannot assert readiness before readback.
Quick on uses installed service startService, retaining Running/Auto background mode. Never silently demote installed service to standalone.
Retain service-backed start/stop; off intent is explicit; listener readiness is required.
IP/provider/region remain visible in details, selectable/copyable; include source and age; no invented values.
Retain measured rx/tx and missing-data state; samples bound to active session generation.

features.target: Overview / Network check / Speed test panel
features.guard: Retain download/upload/latency and Cancel; distinguish target and actual route; avoid making network requests automatically for display.

features.target: Overview / Network check / route and DNS results
features.guard: Preserve inconclusive results, checkedAt and measurement method; no success for every site.

features.target: Overview / route failure / Reapply own route
features.guard: Action visible when active route supports it, bounded to own session/proxy; not global reset.
Retain own-only Internet repair, precise consequences and readback. Keep DNS/TG unless their own operation requires rollback.

features.target: Connection / Import dialog / paste and file
features.guard: Retain clipboard only on explicit action, Ctrl+V and original parsers. Existing file capability may get an explicit entry; not invent source format support.

features.target: Connection / selected subscription or Update all subscriptions
features.guard: Operation label identifies one or all targets; preserve prior usable nodes on failed/empty update.

features.target: Connection / subscription selector, metadata and removal
features.guard: A single subscriptionId controls provider/expiry/quota/update/delete; explicit target and confirm/undo; FC-09 gate.

features.target: Connection / searchable server list / favorite / sort
features.guard: Preserve all existing selection/favorite/sorting. Search is additional local behavior, not replacement. Large-list strategy requires measurements.
Name TCP latency correctly; keep unknown/failed/aged readings; visibility-aware bounded refresh and cancellation.
Retain actual active-server median and method; no claim about game/Telegram/general Internet latency.

features.target: DNS / Ordinary DNS mode / presets and IP fields
features.guard: Preserve presets and primary/secondary fields. One applied configuration, not silently losing ordinary-DNS path.
HTTPS DoH and only truly supported DoT-host conversion. Show unsupported names before mutation; no hidden endpoint rewrite.

features.target: DNS / current configuration and measured checks
features.guard: Retain resolver addresses, provider/protocol/local channel/auto-start/encryption and separate DNS/TCP measurements; unknown remains unknown.

features.target: DNS / Recheck and restore original configuration
features.guard: Recheck is available as normal action; restore is maintenance with owned baseline/adapter scope; protect pending rollback.

features.target: DPI profiles / selection, auto-selection and Cancel
features.guard: Retain actual target coverage, all profiles and cancelled/partial history; no best-profile label from incomplete run.

features.target: DPI profiles / History and Rules tabs
features.guard: Retain domain/IP/CIDR include/exclude fields and save/apply; old backend key names stay. Keyboard tabs preserved.
Standalone remains available as explicit temporary mode with accurate exit/crash/reboot behavior; never masquerades as background service.
Retain install/profile/start/stop/remove; quick action preserves installed background mode. Explicit stop persists through reboot.

features.target: DPI profiles / Rules / game filter and IPSet
features.guard: Retain all existing game-filter modes and IPSet settings/update. Explain runtime scope; no unmeasured loss/jitter claim.
Retain Flowseal update/version selection with integrity/readback and rollback; no blind latest-version preference.

features.target: DPI profiles / Maintenance / Discord cache and WinWS reset
features.guard: Retain both actions with real process-closing/driver consequences and confirmation; not part of routine connect.
Retain listen address, port, masked secret, DC list, buffer/pool/log limit and runtime update preference; dirty draft/conflict handling stays.
Retain install/start/stop/restart/remove. Reinstall/remove in Maintenance, restart/recheck accessible from current state.
OpenLink confirms opening a link only; no invented Telegram acceptance/message delivery.

features.target: Telegram / Events, route details and runtime maintenance
features.guard: Retain route/counters/tail/full logs and runtime update; distinguish upstream latest from compatible installable component.
Startup/tray settings remain independent user choices; shield connect must not force them (FC-07).
Retain auto-connect/reconnect with accurate app dependency and bounded detection/retry budgets.
Keep HWID opt-in and existing notification preference; targeted settings mutation, not whole snapshot replacement.
Retain signed trust/version/progress/block/failure/release page; app/tray required; no autonomous updater promise.
Retain log-folder and archive export; redact URL path secrets, show actual resulting path, no automatic sending.

features.target: Native titlebar, Mini / full, Settings / About
features.guard: Retain minimize/maximize/close/tray and actual package version/About/licenses. Prototype close page is only a scenario description.
Keep API contract and applied:false; do not add a pretend Apply flow before executable backend exists.
Preserve runtime/protocol capability constraints; no blind new settings for disabled kill switch or unsupported runtime capabilities.

acceptance: Exactly the audited 45 feature ids are mapped; neither an omitted visible function nor a hidden API advertised as working.
Prototype is intentionally partial. Runtime migration cannot remove old entrypoints until each relevant action has parity acceptance.
Quick Overview DPI enable starts installed background service and preserves Auto/Running/readiness through app exit and reboot.
Overview retains direct VPN route selection/connect, component controls, measured traffic/speed and scoped recovery, even when shield becomes visually primary.
Mini unknown primary action checks status; preferences do not claim actual state; current DNS/TG start/stop remains an independently named action.
No connected/installed/ready/probe success is generated merely to populate a screenshot.
